title: Teaching model and Yokepedia
note: Commit the teaching model in a claimed lane. People read it as Yokepedia: `yoke dev yokepedia` builds the ignored, self-contained docs/teaching/views/yokepedia.html from the current Yoke source checkout and opens it from a file URL, with no server, session or claim; agents and CI run `yoke dev run -- python3 docs/teaching/tools/build.py` and `--check`. The page embeds the graph, source documents, research records and build freshness, and is replaced only after validation succeeds. Generated output is exempt from authored-file line limits but privacy-scanned. Yokepedia combines Sources, Topics, Journeys and Research. It reads concrete source inventories and preserves canonical research records, explicit references, gaps and evidence. Research remains separate from delivered context; source matches do not prove live delivery. The thirteen source groups remain intact. Dashboard research stays explicitly owned by the dashboard prototype. Superseded proposals are available under History. Use convert_model.py to repair record formatting; CI checks the model and the generated page.
